answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7466 Country: India Title: Question: plz tell me meaning of " kulsoom" " Sameera" "Zaheer" and Yusuf...., and Rohil, Shukyriya / salaam alaikum o rahmatullahi w barakatahu. Answer ID: 7466 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 920/920=M/1429) Kusoom: one having plump cheeks and face, and a silk piece rounded at the head of a flag Sameera: one who tells a story at night, storyteller at night Yusuf: one who is very handsome Zaheer: supportive, helper, friend Rohil: its meaning was not found in the dictionary Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
